title: Blank-first browser workbench (SQLRooms RoomStore, DuckDB-WASM, nine modules)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: `/` opens the saved workspace with no forced dataset; `?sample=operations` is opt-in; nine modules `status: implemented` in src/core/host.ts. Evidence: docs/WORKBENCH_AUTHORING.md, tests/browser/workbench-notebook.spec.ts.

title: Notebook with SQL, allowlisted-model, Jupyter, note and inert cells; explicit dependencies and staleness
acceptance_criteria: Exists: executionPlan runs transitive dependencies in deterministic order; cycles and unknown dependencies refused before any change; edited cells mark dependants Stale. Evidence: src/workspace/notebook.ts, tests/workbench-authoring.test.mjs.

title: SQL cell result as one datapass.artifact v1 with table/chart/JSON views that never rerun
acceptance_criteria: Exists: switching view or chart issues no new query; >10,000 rows stays a preview. Evidence: src/workspace/sql-artifact.ts.

title: Local runtime runs API datapass.runtime/1 (per-launch token, loopback Host/Origin checks, allowlisted models, cancel)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: submit/status/cancel/artifact with X-Datapass-Token; no code is ever sent; artifact checked against recorded SHA-256. Evidence: py/service/runtime.py, src/workspace/runtime.ts, py/service/test_runtime.py.

title: Jupyter kernel adapter (explicit pairing, interrupt, published variable to a bounded DuckDB table)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: stock jupyter_server/ipykernel own execution; states ok/error/interrupted/disconnected/unknown kept distinct; token only in memory. Evidence: src/workspace/jupyter.ts, py/service/jupyter_local.py, tests/browser/workbench-jupyter.spec.ts.

title: .ipynb import/export through pinned nbformat with import report and untrusted-output rules
acceptance_criteria: Exists: import never runs a cell; corrupt notebook refused whole; HTML/SVG shown as text, JS/widgets refused. Evidence: py/service/notebook_io.py, py/service/test_notebook.py.

title: ResultStore: durable local result store (manifest commit point, atomic writes, quota, SHA checks, relink, SQL source hash)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: full disk or quota leaves the previous saved state byte-identical; reopen labels results Not recomputed with 0 runtime or kernel calls. Evidence: py/service/result_store.py, src/workspace/results.ts, qa/M-ROLLBACK.md, qa/M-SQLHASH.md.

title: Workspace persistence datapass.workspace v1 (validated whole, rejected backup, export/import, draft migration)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: newer/corrupt document moved to datapass.workspace.rejected; import validates whole file and changes nothing on error; no rows, payloads or tokens saved. Evidence: src/workspace/persist.ts.

title: Artifact contract datapass.artifact/1 with TypeScript, JSON Schema and Python parity
acceptance_criteria: Exists: 115-file corpus agrees in TS and Python; bounded rows/columns/bytes; provenance synthetic|provided|computed. Evidence: src/framework/foundation/artifact.ts, docs/contracts/artifact.schema.json, py/datapass_artifact.py, npm run test:artifact-corpus.

title: ArtifactStore surface: static artifacts beside the page, write_manifest and the ArtifactSource loader (static, http, fallback)
acceptance_criteria: Exists (no class of that name): loadArtifact fetches same-origin artifacts/<id>.json, bounds, validates and shows role=alert on failure; http source with fallback banner. Evidence: src/framework/foundation/artifact-loader.ts, ArtifactSource.tsx, py/datapass_artifact.py write_manifest.

title: Python bridge levels 1-4: any producer (script, Jupyter, marimo, job) to artifacts; dev live-file watch; FastAPI live service
acceptance_criteria: Exists: watch_write atomic rename; dev plugin pushes datapass:artifact-changed with SHA dedupe; invalid rewrite keeps last valid view. Evidence: docs/PYTHON_BRIDGE.md, scripts/artifact-watch-plugin.mjs, py/service/app.py.

title: Artifact lineage explorer (declared value, representation, artifact, producer, inputs, evidence)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: deterministic graph from the artifact only; nothing is claimed as observed execution. Evidence: src/framework/foundation/lineage/, npm run test:artifact-lineage.

title: SiteRuntime tasks (bounded, cancellable, stale rejection) and createJsonTask same-origin transport
acceptance_criteria: Exists: one runtime per site; task endpoint must be a fixed relative api/ path; view changes never rerun tasks. Evidence: src/framework/runtime.ts, src/framework/http-task.ts.

title: RunJournal with compareRuns and opt-in saved run references (datapass.run-history v1)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: journal observes SiteRuntime without scheduling; references only (no payloads); restored refs labelled not rerun; refused history kept aside. Evidence: src/framework/foundation/journal.ts, run-history.ts, docs/recipes/runs.md.

title: Concept spec v1 with isometric, layer-cake and lazy 3D renderers and a strict validator
acceptance_criteria: Exists: specVersion 1.0.0 schema and examples; node scripts/concept-validate.mjs --strict. Evidence: spec/concept/v1/, src/framework/concept/, docs/CONCEPT_SPEC.md.

title: Standalone concept viewer (one HTML file, open/drop/paste/?src, embed message protocol)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: works over file:// with 0 network requests (JOURNEY-01 step 15). Evidence: dist-standalone/concept-viewer.html, clients/concept-viewer/standalone/.

title: Preview contract datapass.preview/1 written by every build:client and verified by T3
acceptance_criteria: Exists: preview.json with output hashes, artifacts and capabilities; npm run preview:validate -- <file> --check-files. Evidence: spec/preview/v1/, PR #63.

title: D3 viz kit as default chart renderer with crossfilter and optional WebGL marks
acceptance_criteria: Exists: renderer:'vizforge' opt-out per block; ?webgl=0 forces 2D fallback; 3D engine loads on first 3D mark only. Evidence: src/framework/viz/, docs/VISUALIZATION_STACK.md.

title: VizForge story player as the single progression clock (pinned upstream)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: motion and replay controllers wrap the same player; no other autoplay timer. Evidence: upstreams.lock.json (7aaa8fa), src/framework/stories/react.tsx.

title: ConceptMotion semantic explanations (pinned upstream)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: explanation block and workbench Concept lab. Evidence: upstreams.lock.json (30e6963), src/framework/blocks/Explanation.tsx.

title: Authored SVG/D3 motion including isometric projection (motion v1/v2) with SVG and report export
acceptance_criteria: Exists: one finite D3 transition per step; no timers; does not load Three.js. Evidence: src/framework/motion/, docs/MOTION_KIT.md.

title: Three.js optional 3D: scene3d, model3d static GLB profile (hash-checked), viz3d marks, concept 3D
acceptance_criteria: Exists: GLB bytes checked by length and SHA-256 before GLTFLoader; outline fallback before WebGL. Evidence: src/framework/model-assets/, scene-renderer/, docs/MODEL_ASSET_V0_7_QUALIFICATION.md.

title: React Flow surfaces: pipeline designer, architecture review (dbt manifest/catalog import, present mode, script-free HTML report), explorer
acceptance_criteria: Exists: imports bounded and atomic; nothing executes. Evidence: src/panels/Architecture.tsx, src/architecture/, docs/ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW.md.

title: UWData Mosaic linked views through the SQLRooms Mosaic slice
acceptance_criteria: Exists: charts and table share one Mosaic selection. Evidence: src/panels/Linked.tsx, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

title: Client families, capability planning and authoring commands (client:new/check/context/families/dev/build), 19 block types
acceptance_criteria: Exists: client:new never overwrites; capability flags exclude unused engines. Evidence: src/framework/capabilities.ts, scripts/scaffold-client.mjs, docs/PRODUCT_INVENTORY_0.9.md.

title: Selected-client builds with payload/performance gates and CSP connect-src 'self'
acceptance_criteria: Exists: other clients and workbench WASM excluded; npm run test:client-builds. Evidence: scripts/build-client.mjs, scripts/check-client-performance.mjs.

title: SDK release archive (sdk:pack/sdk:verify), release manifest, upgrade and rollback checks; 0.11.0 delivered to the private vault
acceptance_criteria: Exists: 339-file archive, hashes re-verified after authenticated re-download. Evidence: qa/FIN-0.11.0.md, docs/CONSUMING.md, scripts/release-*.mjs.

title: Static knowledge provider, ContextInspector and semantic navigation
acceptance_criteria: Exists: literal search over approved excerpts with exact byte budget; no LLM or vector search. Evidence: src/framework/foundation/knowledge.ts, navigation.ts.

title: Publication metadata (preview/noindex by default, explicit public mode)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: metadata emitted before JavaScript; not deployment. Evidence: scripts/publication.mjs, docs/recipes/public-site.md.

title: Sampled engineering replay on the shared player
acceptance_criteria: Exists: consumes supplied samples; never fills missing data. Evidence: src/framework/replay/, docs/FAMILIES_REPLAY.md.

title: Workbench CSP in shipped _headers allows loopback runtime and Jupyter
acceptance_criteria: Exists on main (#73, f42c8a9); NOT in the 0.11.0 package bytes. Evidence: scripts/workbench-headers.mjs, tests/workbench-headers.test.mjs.

title: Synthetic FOIL client foil-wind (runs, measurements, build-time SQL, run-vs-run comparison)
acceptance_criteria: Exists as a selected-client prototype; committed data is a hand-made placeholder, not FOIL output. Evidence: clients/foil-wind/README.md.

title: param-lab parametric geometry client (client-owned manifold-3d worker, latest-wins rebuilds)
acceptance_criteria: Exists as a prototype; ILLUSTRATIVE geometry. Evidence: clients/param-lab/README.md.

title: Third-party licence inventory generator (repository itself has no licence)
acceptance_criteria: Exists: declared licences recorded; public SDK publication NOT_AUTHORIZED. Evidence: scripts/license-inventory.mjs, docs/licenses/THIRD_PARTY_INVENTORY.md.

title: V1 closure: 0.11.1 immutable package including the CSP fix
acceptance_criteria: New version path built from a clean commit containing f42c8a9; 0.11.0 never overwritten; SHA256SUMS match after authenticated re-download; JOURNEY-01 replayed with the package's own _headers applied.

title: V1 closure: E2E-05 on one vector (Contoso Gold to Studio, React trace on the same Contoso SHA)
acceptance_criteria: One receipt quotes three exact SHAs; Studio >=0.11.1 consumes the Gold export; React trace 14/14 with 7 VERIFIED and 7 INFERRED kept visible; no evidence from other revisions is added up.

title: V1 closure: reconcile E2E-06 with existing T3 receipts
acceptance_criteria: Each E2E-06 clause maps to a T3 receipt or is replayed; no clause is declared equivalent without evidence; T3 remains optional.

title: V1 closure: fix the narrow 'Declared lineage' evidence table on ?artifact=1
acceptance_criteria: Table readable at 1440 px and 390 px (no per-character wrapping); Playwright screenshot inspected and a layout assertion added.

title: V1 closure: install guide works with Git Bash tar and Windows tar.exe
acceptance_criteria: docs/GUIDE extraction command succeeds in Git Bash (--force-local or relative path) and in tar.exe; JOURNEY-02 step 1 replayed with both.

title: Python runtime companion: versioned, hashed archive of py/service and py/datapass_artifact.py
acceptance_criteria: Archive with pinned requirements and a manifest naming source commit and SDK version; installs and starts outside a checkout; a static client without Python still builds and opens; never published publicly.

title: ComputeAdapter: one capability descriptor over the existing compute paths, not a new executor
acceptance_criteria: Descriptor {submit, progress, cancel, interrupt, result, history, durableResult, inputs} implemented by wrapping SiteRuntime tasks, runtime runs, Jupyter kernel, http source and live file; unsupported capabilities reported, never simulated; no scheduler, queue or new process; existing tests unchanged.

title: One run-state vocabulary across notebook and site runs
acceptance_criteria: Documented mapping of runtime RunStatus, Jupyter ExecuteStatus and RunOutcome to one display set (queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, interrupted, superseded, timed out, not observed); stored formats unchanged; labels identical in both surfaces.

title: StorageAdapter facade over the existing ports, not a replacement of the ResultStore
acceptance_criteria: Three tiers (preferences/metadata, immutable content-addressed results, exportable bundles) over persist.ts StoragePort, run-history store and the ResultStore client; only browser key-value and local ResultStore backends; existing formats and rollback check still pass.

title: Concurrent-write safety for the workspace across tabs
acceptance_criteria: Revision counter plus storage-event detection; a second tab's write shows a conflict (keep mine, take theirs, export both); no silent last-writer-wins; covered by a two-page Playwright test.

title: Durable site runs: opt-in save of a client run's artifact and reference to the ResultStore
acceptance_criteria: A client site reopens a saved run 'Not recomputed' after browser and service restart; missing or corrupt result offers Relink or Run again, never a silent fallback; default off.

title: A/B run comparison that survives reopen
acceptance_criteria: Two compatible runs (compareRuns rules) give table/chart deltas; the comparison is saved as a pair of references and reopens without recompute; incompatible model versions refused with the reason.

title: Provenance export bundle (candidate format datapass.bundle/1)
acceptance_criteria: Artifacts, run references, inputs, declared lineage and SHA256SUMS in one file set; re-import validates in TS and Python with identical hashes; no tokens or workspace secrets; sharing review notice shown.

title: Stable diagnostic codes shared by TypeScript and Python validators
acceptance_criteria: Each validator error carries a stable code (e.g. DP-ART-012) documented in one table; the same invalid corpus file yields the same code in both languages; message text kept.

title: doctor check for authors and consumers
acceptance_criteria: Reports Node/npm versions, bootstrapped upstream pins, Python venv and pinned requirements, free ports above 20000, shipped _headers CSP and ResultStore location outside Git; JSON and human output; every failure names its fix.

title: datapass CLI dispatcher over the existing scripts
acceptance_criteria: package.json bin dispatches new, check, context, dev, build, preview-validate, concept-validate, pack, verify, doctor to the existing scripts with no new logic; python -m datapass_artifact validate <file>; npm scripts keep working.

title: Product loop qualified on two consumers (analytics on a Contoso-shape synthetic artifact; foil-wind synthetic)
acceptance_criteria: open client, give parameters, run on an approved producer, inspect table/chart/explanation, compare A/B, close, reopen the same hashes, export with provenance: PASS receipts with hashes on both consumers.

title: Client status metadata (reference, prototype, draft, frozen)
acceptance_criteria: client.config.json declares status; client:check refuses a missing status; ?sites shows it; fabric-bricks is draft/frozen; rule 17 references unchanged.

title: Public entry points as one package export map (authoring, react, compute, storage, testing) with an API report
acceptance_criteria: Exports map in package.json; API report diffed in CI; no new npm packages; consumers importing undeclared internals get a diagnostic.

title: Renderer extension contract without editing the central registry
acceptance_criteria: A client module declares {id, accepts (block type or representation id), capabilities, fallback}; resolved through the client definition; src/framework/registry.tsx unchanged; missing capability shows the declared fallback; proven by two consumers.

title: Additive artifact representation for extension renderers under the migration policy
acceptance_criteria: An ADR decides minor additive vs new discriminator; Python validator, JSON Schema and corpus updated together; old readers refuse rather than strip unknown kinds.

title: Authoring diagnostics overlay (dev builds only)
acceptance_criteria: Shows capability plan, missing or invalid artifacts with codes, stale runs and contract errors; absent from production builds (payload gate proves it).

title: Out-of-tree clients with a pinned SDK archive and an N-1 to N compatibility test
acceptance_criteria: A consumer repository builds, previews, upgrades and rolls back between two SDK versions; clients are never copied into the SDK; CI fixture covers it.

title: Scenario sets on existing runs (named input sets and bounded grids)
acceptance_criteria: Each scenario point is an ordinary run through ComputeAdapter; runtime queue limit (8) respected; cancel per point; comparison via F207; no scheduler, optimizer or second engine.

title: T3 variant helpers on the preview contract
acceptance_criteria: Create variant, build, verify preview.json, compare two previews; client sources stay in Mosaic; T3 stays optional.

title: DiagramCloud gateway through its existing concept-spec export
acceptance_criteria: Imported specs show declared omissions and ID remapping; concept spec v1 stays the only architecture contract here; nothing is round-tripped silently.

title: Testing kit for consumers (fake runtime and Jupyter servers, artifact fixtures)
acceptance_criteria: Fakes already used in tests/ exported under the testing entry; a consumer CI runs them without Python.

title: Remote or multi-user runtime (parked)
acceptance_criteria: Only after a threat model, authentication, isolation and cost review; never a default service; the local loop works without it.

title: RemoteStore / generic sync backend (parked)
acceptance_criteria: Only when a selected consumer needs it; conflict model reuses F205; local stores unchanged.

title: IndexedDB backend for large in-browser results (conditional)
acceptance_criteria: Only on a measured need above localStorage limits; same tiers and validation as F204.

title: Public SDK publication (blocked by the licence decision)
acceptance_criteria: Owner licence decision recorded first; until then NOT_AUTHORIZED.

title: PDF/PPTX/video exports (parked)
acceptance_criteria: Re-evaluate on a selected consumer need; script-free HTML and SVG exports stay the default.

title: Anatomy lab client: one FOIL mechanical figure and one architecture explainer, SVG first
acceptance_criteria: Isolated clients/anatomy-lab (not rule 17, not in the workbench); kit vendored at a pinned commit through upstreams.lock.json with the MIT notice; static SVG output; synthetic and ILLUSTRATIVE labels.

title: Anatomy pose driven by SiteRuntime view fields or the StoryPlayer step
acceptance_criteria: No idle autoplay or tour; only finite eased transitions; reduced motion holds one still pose; changing pose never reruns a calculation.

title: Figure provenance: readout numbers come from validated artifact values
acceptance_criteria: Each displayed number names artifact id, SHA and representation; figure carries an evidence sidecar; no number is typed into the drawing.

title: Anatomy WebGL layer and 3D beta evaluation (after R01-R03)
acceptance_criteria: Measured payload and frame rate on a phone profile; SVG reads without WebGL; not adopted as a central engine.

title: Architecture explainer selection shared with concept spec node ids
acceptance_criteria: Selecting a figure part selects the same concept node through a view field; no second architecture model.
